test_queries_run.query: PostgreSQL database connections exhausted under heavy traffic spikes

top_matches.title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Exhaustion under Flash Traffic
top_matches.root_cause: Application microservices opened unpooled TCP connections, exhausting max_connections (500) during seasonal sale event.
top_matches.resolution: Implemented PgBouncer connection pooling in transaction mode and tuned TimescaleDB worker pools.

top_matches.title: Redis Cache Eviction Storm due to Missing TTL on Session Keys
top_matches.root_cause: Auth service omission of EXPIRE on OAuth state tokens filled memory, causing volatile-lru to evict critical user sessions.
top_matches.resolution: Enforced default TTL of 3600 seconds on all auth keys and deployed Redis Cluster replica shard.

top_matches.title: Kubernetes OOMKilled Pod Crash on Memory Leak in Ingestion Worker
top_matches.root_cause: Buffer accumulation in Python background consumer caused process to breach 4Gi limit, triggering kernel OOM killer.
top_matches.resolution: Converted in-memory list buffering to streaming generators and set cgroup memory limit to 8Gi with proactive alerts.

top_matches.title: Slow Query Latency on IoT Dashboard due to Missing Hypertable Index
top_matches.root_cause: Dashboard queries performed sequential scans across unindexed device_id column on decompressed chunks.
top_matches.resolution: Created composite index on (device_id, time DESC) and enabled Continuous Aggregates for 1-hour rollups.
